clippings.speaker: Ridley Scott
clippings.quote: So Baaba and Hans and I sat in a Sony room and Baaba would say, “Okay, run it.” … Now, Hans is very much a prepared, orchestral, knowledgeable musician and composer but Baaba was much more of a “from the hip” musician, because that’s how he functions.
clippings.title: 'Black Hawk Down': When Ridley Scott Went To War
clippings.context: Scott describing the scoring sessions with Zimmer and Senegalese singer Baaba Maal.

clippings.speaker: Hans Zimmer
clippings.quote: And I woke up to Ridley being right in the guy's face, 'Don't you ever talk to my composer like this.' And you know how those little things give you a sense of a bonding experience.
clippings.title: Ray Colcord Interviews Hans Zimmer
clippings.context: Zimmer recalls fainting after a producer berated him at a Black Rain preview, their first film together.

clippings.speaker: Hans Zimmer
clippings.quote: Then Ridley [Scott] came in, and he was going, "I don't know about this." He literally said, and this was on a Friday, he said, "Let me come back on Monday." … Monday I played him the main theme. He actually added a scene at the beginning of the movie because he loved that tune so much.
clippings.title: Composer Hans Zimmer On The Questions That Drive Him [Interview]
clippings.context: Zimmer on the pressure of writing the Thelma & Louise main theme.

clippings.speaker: Hans Zimmer
clippings.quote: Somehow Ridley Scott and his Gladiator made it possible for me to just play again and so on a strictly personal level, Gladiator was a great way of rediscovering my joy in music.
clippings.title: Hans Zimmer and the Gladiator
clippings.context: Interview with Ian Lace; Zimmer says Gladiator restored his love of writing after The Thin Red Line.

clippings.speaker: Hans Zimmer
clippings.quote: All those sequences, all the action music was written before Ridley had finished shooting. Part of it was written on the battlefield. Ridley would cut the film at my Lilly Yard Studio so we were actually 'joined at the hip' every day.
clippings.title: Hans Zimmer and the Gladiator
clippings.context: Same interview, on writing the battle music while Scott was still shooting.

clippings.speaker: Hans Zimmer
clippings.quote: I would somehow figure out what would help Ridley to be poetic, because I know that’s what he wants to do.
clippings.title: Hollywood Masters: Hans Zimmer
clippings.context: Zimmer at LMU's Hollywood Masters series, calling Scott a painter and a poet.

notes: Scott-on-Zimmer is thin: only the 2019 Deadline interview verified; the oft-cited 'talk pictures with Hans' line is from a 1991 video clip with no transcript found. SCL page is Cloudflare-blocked to curl; its quote was confirmed sentence by sentence via WebFetch, so its date is the web posting date.
